Title: Video Indexer is now ISO, SOC, HiTRUST, FedRAMP, HIPAA, PCI certified

Body.Content:
To help you meet your compliance obligations across regulated industries and markets worldwide, Video Indexer is now ISO 27001, ISO 27018, SOC 1,2,3, HIPAA, FedRAMP, HITRUST, and PCI certified. See the full certification status of Video Indexer along with all other Azure services.

Azure maintains the largest compliance portfolio in the industry both in terms of total number of offerings, as well as number of customer-facing services in assessment scope.

Please contact us if you have questions or feedback on Video Indexer, Use our UserVoice to help us prioritize features, or email us  with any questions.
